mainText: Good morning. It's Friday, October 9th. Markets are open for a regular session. Index futures are pointing higher: Dow futures up about a tenth of a percent, S and P 500 futures up about four tenths, and Nasdaq futures up nearly a full percent, as AI names rebound from yesterday's selloff. The ten year Treasury yield is about five point two five percent. In premarket movers: Humana is up fifteen percent on strong Medicare Advantage ratings. Lennar is up nineteen percent, the biggest gainer. Tower stocks like Crown Castle are up seven percent or more on news that SpaceX bought spectrum to build a wireless carrier, which is pushing AT and T, T-Mobile, and Verizon down about seven percent each. Apple is down two and a half percent on weak iPhone demand news, and Delta is down nearly three percent after missing earnings. Consumer sentiment data is due later this morning.
